capabilities: Open a File Explorer tab rooted to a chosen folder via context menu
Open single or multiple rooted explorer views
Pick a custom tab icon from an icon picker
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; desktop only.
intentEvidence: Open additional Obsidian File Explorer tabs rooted to a specific folder.
problem: Obsidian's built-in File Explorer only shows the full vault tree, so focusing on one folder requires wading through unrelated files.
summary: File Explorer extension that opens additional explorer tabs rooted to a chosen folder instead of the whole vault.
